blocks.text: Purpose: the Sinhala wording below was drafted by AI as a first pass for a shoe catalog website (menu labels, buttons, and a WhatsApp inquiry message). Please review each row and write your corrected Sinhala in the "Translator's Correction" column. Leave it blank if the current wording is already correct.

items: Keep the tone friendly and simple — this is for everyday customers buying shoes via WhatsApp, not formal/legal text.
In the WhatsApp message template, keep {name}, {code} and {price} exactly as written — these are placeholders the website fills in automatically with the real product name, code, and price.
"රු." is being used as a short form for Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) — change it if you prefer a different convention.
Section 3 (Category names) and Section 4 (Type names) are simple one or two word labels shown as small tags/filters on the site.

rows: Browse our shoes below and tap "Inquire on WhatsApp" to order.
අපගේ සපත්තු එකතුව පහතින් බලන්න. නියම කරගැනීමට 'WhatsApp මගින් විමසන්න' බොත්තම ඔබන්න.
Out of stock (badge on product photo)
No products yet — check back soon!
තවම නිෂ්පාදන නැත — නැවත පරීක්ෂා කරන්න!
මෙම පෙරහන් වලට ගැළපෙන නිෂ්පාදන නැත.

blocks.text: This is the message that opens in WhatsApp when a customer taps "Inquire on WhatsApp" on a product. {name}, {code}, {price} are placeholders — keep them exactly as shown, anywhere in the sentence.

rows: Hi! I'm interested in *{name}* (Code: {code}), priced at LKR {price}. Is it available?
ආයුබෝවන්! මට *{name}* (කේතය: {code}) ගැන උනන්දුවක් තියෙනවා. මිල: රු. {price}. මේක දැනට තියෙනවද?
